condition: recombinant cargo-free T4GALA engineered shell expressed in E. coli; trigger-responsive disassembly/reassembly
notes: Engineered E-loop insertion variant designed for triggered reversible disassembly. T4GALA retains the global T=4 240-mer architecture and is approximately 42 nm in diameter, nearly identical to WT QtEnc, but cryo-EM shows substantial loss of ordered density around the engineered E-loop/GALA insertion site, consistent with increased local structural dynamics. PDB 7MH2 / EMD-23834.
shell_change_alignment_note: 22-aa insertion aligned from the curated T4GALA design to 282-aa WT QtEnc reference; not a claim of experimentally verified plasmid identity.
